exact_structure_upper_bound.non_deployable_reason: reads exact full oracle label set for upper bound only

arm_definitions_and_budget_parity.principle: Matched evidence and query budgets isolate the structural method.

duration_s.principle: Measured wall time exposes bootstrap-only artifacts.

field_provenance.principle: Every metric traces to rows, queries, cores, or state receipts.

honest_verdict.principle: A terminal prefix states credited, null, negative, or blocked outcome honestly.

oracle_boundary_violation_count.principle: A bare zero proves deployable arms never read sealed structure labels.

paired_deltas_and_ci95.principle: Paired intervals quantify lift over the successful template baseline.

per_arm_family_change_metrics.principle: Disaggregated results prevent a pooled average from hiding family failures.

preconditions_checked.principle: Gate, hashes, headroom, solvers, resources, and checkpoints prevent fabricated execution.

protected_prefix_and_safety.principle: Zero regression and unsafe propagation are required for adaptive learning.

query_and_minimal_core_receipts.principle: Exact boundary evidence shows how each structure was learned without leaking labels.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A checksum detects drift in arms, rows, seeds, or metrics.

retire_if_same_verdict.principle: A repeated blocked outcome mechanically retires this reattempt.

status.principle: A terminal experiment state distinguishes completed negative evidence from an incomplete run.

structural_hypothesis_grammar.principle: A frozen grammar makes out-of-template expressivity and complexity auditable.

structural_learner_ready_score.principle: EMIT BARE scalar; only 1.0 permits the future-validated lifecycle.

structural_recovery_and_headroom.principle: Credit is restricted to genuinely expressible, headroom-present science rows.

test_commands.principle: Commands document parity, leakage, recovery, statistics, and safety checks.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes prevent failed evaluations from becoming readiness.

upstream_artifact_hashes.principle: Hashes bind learning to the sealed certified event stream.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: True records that exact solvers label and gate updates, so no moat claim is allowed.
